[[Auri the Skull Wand]] is a [[Human]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Kinya Province]].

== Locations ==
* [[Shing Jea Island]]
** {{NPC location|Kinya Province}} (a short distance south from the exit into [[Sunqua Vale]])

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Armor of Earth}}
* {{skill icon|Conjure Lightning}}
* {{skill icon|Immolate}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Auri's Wand]] ([[unique]])
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Bolt of Linen]]
* [[Crimson Skull Cape]]
* [[Silver Crimson Skull Coin]]

== Notes ==
* Does not spawn during [[A Strange Request]].

== Trivia ==
* Whenever out of combat, Auri will periodically perform the male warrior dance emote (usually looping the first part of the dance). His followers will each perform one of the various music instruments emotes (from east to west : /flute, /drum, /violin, /guitar).
